headline: 2 Software Stocks to Target This Week and 1 We Question
summary: From commerce to culture, software is digitizing every aspect of our lives. This secular theme has materialized in superior earnings growth and stock price performance for most SaaS companies, and over the last six months, the industry’s 13.5% return has topped the S&P 500 by 8.6 percentage points.

headline: Trade Desk (TTD) Nears Earnings, Is The 38% Undervalued View Still Intact?
